adversarial_pairs.note: One word different (Illness vs Specified Illness), 4x different waiting period (30 vs 120 days) -- the single most dangerous near-miss in this set.
adversarial_pairs.question_a: How long is the waiting period for Illness?
adversarial_pairs.question_b: How long is the waiting period for a Specified Illness?

adversarial_pairs.note: Both 'is theft covered' in shape, opposite answers -- forcible entry into the home is covered (Clause A2.4), theft from an unattended vehicle is excluded (Exclusion 5.2.6).
adversarial_pairs.question_a: Is theft from my house covered if someone broke in?
adversarial_pairs.question_b: Is theft from my car covered?

adversarial_pairs.note: Both 'how much do I pay myself' in shape, but Section A uses a flat Excess and Section B uses a Co-insurance percentage -- different mechanism entirely, not just a different number.
adversarial_pairs.question_a: How much do I pay out of pocket for a property damage claim?
adversarial_pairs.question_b: How much do I pay out of pocket for a hospital claim?

adversarial_pairs.note: Both about tier upgrades/changes, opposite waiting-period treatment -- an upgrade re-triggers waiting periods for the added benefits, a downgrade does not.
adversarial_pairs.question_a: If I upgrade my tier, do the waiting periods start over?
adversarial_pairs.question_b: If I downgrade my tier, do the waiting periods start over?

adversarial_pairs.note: Both about missing a payment, very different consequence -- a missed MONTHLY instalment has a 30-day grace period before lapse; there is no grace period for annual premium at all.
adversarial_pairs.question_a: What happens if I miss a monthly premium payment?
adversarial_pairs.question_b: What happens if I miss my annual premium payment?

adversarial_pairs.note: Both 'is a second claim covered', different exclusion logic entirely -- a readmission within 90 days is the SAME Disability (one claim, same limit); a second Escape of Water claim just consumes the per-event limit again (no readmission-style bundling rule at all).
adversarial_pairs.question_a: If I'm readmitted to hospital for the same condition within 90 days, is that a new claim?
adversarial_pairs.question_b: If I have a second Escape of Water claim, is that a new claim?
